24|26 weeks (both adjusted one-sided P < 0.001) and exenatide at 26 and 52 weeks
25|(both adjusted one-sided P < 0.001). Greater percentages of patients reached
26|HbA1c targets with dulaglutide 1.5 mg and 0.75 mg than with placebo and exena-

32|CONCLUSIONS
33|Both once-weekly dulaglutide doses demonstrated superior glycemic control ver-
